WITH total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
by_trans_type AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
)
SELECT 
  bt.tradekind,
  AVG(bt.count) AS avg_count,
  AVG(bt.count * 100.0 / t.total_count) AS avg_share
FROM by_trans_type bt
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY bt.tradekind
ORDER BY bt.tradekind;
